note: FIXED taxonomy. 18 professional sectors. Do not add, rename, merge or split. Every profession has exactly one parent here.

cross_cutting_rule.statement: Employers that span many professions — Defence and the Armed Forces, Police, ISRO, Railways, Government — are INDUSTRIAL SECTOR TAGS, not professional sectors.
cross_cutting_rule.resolution: The uniformed or institutional identity goes under Law, Governance & Public Service. Specialist roles keep their home sector and carry the relevant industrial tag.

professional_sectors.name: Software & Computing
professional_sectors.scope: Building, running and securing software, data and computer systems.

professional_sectors.name: Engineering & Making
professional_sectors.scope: Designing, building and maintaining physical things and systems. Includes distributed skilled trades, separated by the degree_dependency tag rather than by sector.

professional_sectors.name: Science & Research
professional_sectors.scope: Producing new empirical knowledge. Includes pure and research psychology.

professional_sectors.name: Healthcare & Medicine
professional_sectors.scope: Diagnosing and treating the human or animal body.

professional_sectors.name: Business, Management & Entrepreneurship
professional_sectors.scope: Running organisations, selling, and starting ventures.

professional_sectors.name: Finance & Economics
professional_sectors.scope: Money, capital, risk and the study of economies.

professional_sectors.name: Law, Governance & Public Service
professional_sectors.scope: Three families: Law & Justice (lawyer, judge, prosecutor) + Civil & Administrative Services (IAS, IPS, IRS) + Policy & Diplomacy.
professional_sectors.boundary: ONLY careers whose work exists because the state or justice system exists. A profession that merely works FOR government stays in its home sector and carries a Government industrial tag instead.

professional_sectors.name: Design & Creative Arts
professional_sectors.scope: Making things look, feel and work well. Visual and applied craft.

professional_sectors.name: Media, Film & Storytelling
professional_sectors.scope: Telling stories and moving information to an audience.

professional_sectors.name: Performing Arts & Music
professional_sectors.scope: Live and recorded performance: music, dance, theatre.

professional_sectors.name: Education & Training
professional_sectors.scope: Teaching anything, to anyone, at any level. Subject does not change the parent sector.

professional_sectors.name: Social Impact & Psychology
professional_sectors.scope: INTERVENE on wellbeing. Applied psychology, counselling, social work, development sector.

professional_sectors.name: Environment & Sustainability
professional_sectors.scope: Protecting and managing natural systems and the climate.

professional_sectors.name: Agriculture & Food Systems
professional_sectors.scope: Growing, breeding, processing and moving food and fibre.

professional_sectors.name: Humanities, Culture & Belief
professional_sectors.scope: INTERPRET and PRESERVE ideas, heritage and faith.

professional_sectors.name: Personal Care & Wellness
professional_sectors.scope: Care of the body and appearance outside clinical medicine.
